title: Hierarchical design of silkworm silk for functional composites
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00776J, Review Article
Kang Yang, Jingwu Zhang, Chen Zhang, Juan Guan, Shengjie Ling, Zhengzhong Shao
Natural silkworm silk fibers can be made into woven fabrics, long-stranded structures, and nanometer fibrils. Silk-reinforced composites (SRCs) combine the unique properties of these forms of silk, offering enhanced mechanical strength, biocompatibility, and biodegradability.
